import pathlib,json,subprocess,hashlib,os
R=pathlib.Path('.local/step07-review/independent-round13'); MAIN=pathlib.Path('/Users/dingshinn/Desktop/rpg-maker-maker');DOC='8e437ccfccba2c9b98cc713b002e62acfb739465';SOURCE='1be820a5adfbb3c41c532fbc778958774ed1c470'
def get(c,p):return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',c+':'+p])
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def save(n,v):(R/'evidence'/n).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
report=get(DOC,'docs/reviews/step-07-ci-required-body-coding.md');lb=get(DOC,'docs/evidence/step-07/ci-required-body/ledger.json');L=json.loads(lb)
assert sha(report)=='f26dd1a375db8ff084dea0a6e0755dc2562ee9b7c36727af75b4773620706dbc';assert sha(lb)=='5e6d3033e3a608a785aec27308098cb2dddbe95d2b2dcab1b3fb27a993dbd1f4'
print('author file sample',str(list(L['files'].items())[:1])[:1600]);print('build',L['build']);
prior=[]
for n in range(4,13):
 base=MAIN/f'docs/evidence/step-07/independent-round{n}';p=base/'evidence/ledger.json';b=p.read_bytes();v=json.loads(b);entries=v['files']; entries=[{'path':k,**m} for k,m in entries.items()] if isinstance(entries,dict) else entries
 count=0
 for e in entries:
  q=base/e['path'];bb=q.read_bytes(); assert len(bb)==e['bytes'] and sha(bb)==e['sha256'],str(q);count+=1
 prior.append({'round':n,'reportSHA256':sha((base/'report.md').read_bytes()),'reportBytes':(base/'report.md').stat().st_size,'ledgerSHA256':sha(b),'payloadsVerified':count,'source':v['source'],'result':v['result']})
save('prior-ledgers-audit.json',prior)
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','428d981925bc265527b32409f51f9cc5cc149c8c',SOURCE],text=True).splitlines();post=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',SOURCE,DOC],text=True).splitlines();assert all(p.startswith('docs/') for p in post)
save('source-diff-audit.json',{'parentDocs':'428d981925bc265527b32409f51f9cc5cc149c8c','changed':changed,'postSourceDocsPaths':post,'source':SOURCE,'docs':DOC,'authorReportSHA256':sha(report),'authorLedgerSHA256':sha(lb)})
print(json.dumps({'prior':prior,'changed':changed,'postSourcePaths':len(post)},ensure_ascii=False))
AUTHOR=pathlib.Path('/Users/dingshinn/.codex/worktrees/step-07-studio/rpg-maker-maker')
author=[]
for name,e in L['files'].items():
 b=get(DOC,name);assert len(b)==e['bytes'] and sha(b)==e['sha256'],name
 row={'path':name,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':sha(b),'committedVerified':True}
 if e.get('originalPath'):
  p=pathlib.Path(e['originalPath']);p=p if p.is_absolute() else AUTHOR/p
  assert p.is_relative_to(AUTHOR) or p.is_relative_to(MAIN),str(p)
  bb=p.read_bytes();assert len(bb)==e['originalBytes'] and sha(bb)==e['originalSHA256'],str(p)
  row.update({'actualOriginalVerified':True,'originalPath':e['originalPath'],'originalSHA256':sha(bb)})
 author.append(row)
save('author-payload-audit.json',{'payloadCount':len(author),'actualOriginalCount':sum(x.get('actualOriginalVerified',False) for x in author),'files':author})
B=AUTHOR/L['build']['manifestPath'];bb=B.read_bytes();assert sha(bb)==L['build']['manifestSHA256'];M=json.loads(bb)
save('engineering-manifest.json',M)
rows=[]
for e in L['build']['files']:
 p=B.parent/e['path'];bb=p.read_bytes();assert sha(bb)==e['sha256'] and len(bb)==e['bytes'],str(p);rows.append(e)
save('author-engineering-files.json',{'build':L['build']['buildId'],'manifestSHA256':sha(B.read_bytes()),'actualImmutableFilesVerified':len(rows),'manifestOriginalPath':str(B),'files':rows})
print('AUTHOR_PAYLOAD_AND_ACTUAL_ENGINEERING_OK',len(author),len(rows))
